create procedure CDN.DzlKodDzialu @SourceName VARCHAR(255), @SourceDatabase VARCHAR(255), @p_DzlId int, @returns varchar(40) OUTPUT as begin
declare @Kod varchar(40) declare @DZL_ParentId int
DECLARE @sql NVARCHAR(4000) DECLARE @params NVARCHAR(4000)
select @sql = N' select @Kod=(case when DZL_LokId=1 then DZL_Kod else '''' end),@DZL_ParentId=DZL_ParentId from ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase +'].CDN.Dzialy where DZL_DzlId=@p_DzlId ' SELECT @params =N'@p_DzlId int, @Kod varchar(40) OUTPUT, @DZL_ParentId int OUTPUT' EXEC sp_executesql @sql, @params, @p_DzlId, @Kod OUTPUT,@DZL_ParentId OUTPUT
if @Kod is not null and @Kod<>'' SET @returns = @Kod ELSE BEGIN select @sql = N' select @Kod=DZL_Kod from ['+@SourceName+'].['+@SourceDatabase +'].CDN.Dzialy where DZL_DzlId=@DZL_ParentId ' SELECT @params =N'@Kod varchar(40) OUTPUT, @DZL_ParentId int ' EXEC sp_executesql @sql, @params, @Kod OUTPUT,@DZL_ParentId
SET @returns = @Kod END end
